# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Check for redundant line continuation.
      #
      # This cop marks a line continuation as redundant if removing the backslash
      # does not result in a syntax error.
      # However, a backslash at the end of a comment or
      # for string concatenation is not redundant and is not considered an offense.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   foo. \
      #     bar
      #   foo \
      #     &.bar \
      #       .baz
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo.
      #     bar
      #   foo
      #     &.bar
      #       .baz
      #
      #   # bad
      #   [foo, \
      #     bar]
      #   {foo: \
      #     bar}
      #
      #   # good
      #   [foo,
      #     bar]
      #   {foo:
      #     bar}
      #
      #   # bad
      #   foo(bar, \
      #     baz)
      #
      #   # good
      #   foo(bar,
      #     baz)
      #
      #   # also good - backslash in string concatenation is not redundant
      #   foo('bar' \
      #     'baz')
      #
      #   # also good - backslash at the end of a comment is not redundant
      #   foo(bar, # \
      #     baz)
      #
      #   # also good - backslash at the line following the newline begins with a + or -,
      #   # it is not redundant
      #   1 \
      #     + 2 \
      #       - 3
      #
      #   # also good - backslash with newline between the method name and its arguments,
      #   # it is not redundant.
      #   some_method \
      #     (argument)
      #
      class RedundantLineContinuation < Base
        include MatchRange
        extend AutoCorrector

        MSG = 'Redundant line continuation.'
        LINE_CONTINUATION = '\\'
        LINE_CONTINUATION_PATTERN = /(\\\n)/.freeze
        ALLOWED_STRING_TOKENS = %i[tSTRING tSTRING_CONTENT].freeze
        ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[
          kDEF kFALSE kNIL kSELF kTRUE tCONSTANT tCVAR tFLOAT tGVAR tIDENTIFIER tINTEGER tIVAR
          tLBRACK tLCURLY tLPAREN_ARG tSTRING tSTRING_BEG tSYMBOL tXSTRING_BEG
        ].freeze
        ARGUMENT_TAKING_FLOW_TOKEN_TYPES = %i[tIDENTIFIER kRETURN kBREAK kNEXT kYIELD].freeze

        CONCAT_TOKEN_TYPES = %i[tPLUS tLSHFT].freeze
        SIMPLE_STRING_TOKEN_TYPE = :tSTRING
        COMPLEX_STRING_BEGIN_TOKEN = :tSTRING_BEG
        COMPLEX_STRING_END_TOKEN = :tSTRING_END
        HIGH_PRECEDENCE_OP_TOKEN_TYPES = %i[tSTAR2 tPERCENT tDOT tLBRACK2].freeze
        QUOTE_DELIMITERS = %w[' "].freeze
        LINE_1_ENDING = /['"]\s*\\\n/.freeze
        LINE_2_BEGINNING = /\A\s*['"]/.freeze
        LEADING_STYLE_OFFENSE = /(?<trailing_spaces>\s+)(?<ending>#{LINE_1_ENDING})/.freeze
        TRAILING_STYLE_OFFENSE = /(?<beginning>#{LINE_2_BEGINNING})(?<leading_spaces>\s+)/.freeze
        HIDDEN_FILE_PATTERN = "#{::File::SEPARATOR}."

        def on_new_investigation
          return unless processed_source.ast

          bind_continuation_context
          return unless @continuation_state[:ast]

          each_continuation_match do |range|
            next if require_line_continuation?(range)
            next unless redundant_line_continuation?(range)

            add_offense(range) do |corrector|
              corrector.remove_leading(range, 1)
            end
          end

          inspect_end_of_ruby_code_line_continuation
        end

        def self.coordinate_relative_path(path, base_dir)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_context, path, base_dir)
          worker.__send__(:relative_path_from_base)
        end

        def self.coordinate_smart_path(path)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_context, path, ::Dir.pwd)
          worker.__send__(:smart_path_for)
        end

        def self.coordinate_match_path(pattern, path)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_pattern, pattern, path)
          worker.__send__(:match_path_pattern?)
        end

        def self.coordinate_glob_path(path)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_context, path, ::Dir.pwd)
          worker.__send__(:glob_path?)
        end

        def self.coordinate_absolute_path(path)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_context, path, ::Dir.pwd)
          worker.__send__(:absolute_path?)
        end

        def self.coordinate_continuation_spacing(cop)
          worker = new(cop.config, cop.instance_variable_get(:@options))
          worker.begin_investigation(cop.processed_source)
          worker.__send__(:bind_spacing_context, cop)
          worker.__send__(:perform_continuation_spacing)
        end

        def self.coordinate_leading_space(cop, node)
          worker = new(cop.config, cop.instance_variable_get(:@options))
          worker.begin_investigation(cop.processed_source)
          worker.__send__(:bind_leading_context, cop, node)
          worker.__send__(:perform_leading_space)
        end

        def self.coordinate_line_end_concatenation(cop)
          worker = new(cop.config, cop.instance_variable_get(:@options))
          worker.begin_investigation(cop.processed_source)
          worker.__send__(:bind_concat_context, cop)
          worker.__send__(:perform_line_end_concatenation)
        end

        def self.coordinate_breakable_node(owner, node, max)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_breakable_context, owner, node, max)
          worker.__send__(:extract_breakable_node_for_owner)
        end

        def self.coordinate_check_for_breakable_node(owner, node)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_breakable_context, owner, node, owner.send(:max))
          worker.__send__(:check_for_breakable_node_for_owner)
        end

        def self.coordinate_hidden_file(path)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_context, path, ::Dir.pwd)
          worker.__send__(:hidden_file_name?)
        end

        def self.coordinate_hidden_dir(path)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_context, path, ::Dir.pwd)
          worker.__send__(:hidden_dir_name?)
        end

        def self.coordinate_maybe_hidden_file(path)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_context, path, ::Dir.pwd)
          worker.__send__(:maybe_hidden_file_name?)
        end

        def self.coordinate_hidden_file_in_not_hidden_dir(pattern, path)
          worker = allocate
          worker.__send__(:bind_path_pattern, pattern, path)
          worker.__send__(:hidden_file_in_not_hidden_dir?)
        end

        private

        def bind_continuation_context
          @continuation_state = {
            source: processed_source,
            tokens: processed_source.tokens,
            ast: processed_source.ast,
            raw: processed_source.raw_source,
            range: nil,
            node: nil
          }
        end

        def each_continuation_match
          return unless continuation_ast_range

          each_match_range(continuation_ast_range, LINE_CONTINUATION_PATTERN) do |range|
            @continuation_state[:range] = range
            yield range
          end
        end

        def require_line_continuation?(range)
          @continuation_state[:range] = range
          continuation_missing_plain_backslash? ||
            continuation_is_string_join? ||
            continuation_starts_with_arithmetic? ||
            continuation_inside_literal_or_argument? ||
            continuation_leading_dot_with_blank_line?
        end

        def continuation_missing_plain_backslash?

          !ends_with_backslash_without_comment?(@continuation_state[:range].source_line)
        end

        def continuation_is_string_join?

          string_concatenation?(@continuation_state[:range].source_line) ||
            continuation_string_delimiter?(@continuation_state[:range].source_line) &&
              string_concatenation?(@continuation_state[:range].source_line)
        end

        def continuation_starts_with_arithmetic?

          start_with_arithmetic_operator?(continuation_next_line_text(@continuation_state[:range]))
        end

        def continuation_inside_literal_or_argument?

          inside_string_literal_or_method_with_argument?(@continuation_state[:range])
        end

        def continuation_leading_dot_with_blank_line?

          leading_dot_method_chain_with_blank_line?(@continuation_state[:range])
        end

        def ends_with_backslash_without_comment?(source_line)
          return unless @continuation_state

          continuation_backslash_line?(source_line)
        end

        def string_concatenation?(source_line)
          return unless @continuation_state

          /["']\s*\\\z/.match?(source_line)
        end

        def inside_string_literal_or_method_with_argument?(range)
          @continuation_state[:range] = range
          line_range = range_by_whole_lines(range)

          continuation_token_pairs.any? do |token, next_token|
            next if token.line == next_token.line

            inside_string_literal?(range, token) ||
              method_with_argument?(line_range, token, next_token)
          end
        end

        def leading_dot_method_chain_with_blank_line?(range)
          @continuation_state[:range] = range
          return false unless range.source_line.strip.start_with?('.', '&.')

          @continuation_state[:source][range.line].strip.empty?
        end

        def redundant_line_continuation?(range)
          @continuation_state[:range] = range
          @continuation_state[:node] = find_node_for_line(range.last_line)
          return true unless @continuation_state[:node]
          return false if argument_newline?(@continuation_state[:node])

          source = continuation_raw_dup
          source[range.begin_pos, range.length] = "\n"
          parse(source).valid_syntax?
        end

        def inspect_end_of_ruby_code_line_continuation
          return unless @continuation_state[:source] && continuation_last_ast_line

          last_line = continuation_source_lines[continuation_last_ast_line - 1]
          return unless last_line.end_with?(LINE_CONTINUATION)

          last_column = last_line.length
          line_continuation_range = range_between(last_column - 1, last_column)
          @continuation_state[:range] = line_continuation_range

          add_offense(line_continuation_range) do |corrector|
            corrector.remove_trailing(line_continuation_range, 1)
          end
        end

        def inside_string_literal?(range, token)
          return unless @continuation_state

          ALLOWED_STRING_TOKENS.include?(token.type) && continuation_token_overlap?(token, range)
        end

        def method_with_argument?(line_range, current_token, next_token)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless continuation_flow_token?(current_token)
          return false unless continuation_token_overlap?(current_token, line_range)

          argument_type_token?(next_token)
        end

        def argument_type_token?(token)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless token

          ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(token.type)
        end

        def argument_newline?(node)
          @continuation_state[:node] = node
          node = node.to_a.last if continuation_assignment_target?(node)
          return false if node.parenthesized_call?

          node = node.children.first if continuation_root_begin?(node)

          if argument_is_method?(node)
            argument_newline?(node.first_argument)
          else
            return false unless method_call_with_arguments?(node)

            !continuation_selector_on_same_line?(node)
          end
        end

        def find_node_for_line(last_line)

          @continuation_state[:ast].each_node do |node|
            @continuation_state[:node] = node
            return node if same_line?(node, last_line)
          end
        end

        def same_line?(node, line)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless (source_range = node.source_range)

          if node.is_a?(AST::StrNode)
            if node.heredoc?
              (node.loc.heredoc_body.line..node.loc.heredoc_body.last_line).cover?(line)
            else
              (source_range.line..source_range.last_line).cover?(line)
            end
          else
            source_range.line == line
          end
        end

        def argument_is_method?(node)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless node.send_type?
          return false unless (first_argument = node.first_argument)

          method_call_with_arguments?(first_argument)
        end

        def method_call_with_arguments?(node)
          return unless @continuation_state

          node.call_type? && !node.arguments.empty?
        end

        def start_with_arithmetic_operator?(source_line)
          return unless @continuation_state

          %r{\A\s*[+\-*/%]}.match?(source_line)
        end

        def continuation_comment_stripped_line(source_line)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return '' unless source_line

          source_line.gsub(/#.+/, '')
        end

        def continuation_backslash_line?(source_line)
          return unless @continuation_state

          continuation_comment_stripped_line(source_line).end_with?('\\')
        end

        def continuation_string_delimiter?(source_line)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless source_line

          source_line.rstrip.end_with?("'", '"') || /["']\s*\\\z/.match?(source_line)
        end

        def continuation_flow_token?(token)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless token

          ARGUMENT_TAKING_FLOW_TOKEN_TYPES.include?(token.type)
        end

        def continuation_token_overlap?(token, range)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless token && range

          token.pos.overlaps?(range)
        end
        def continuation_next_line_text(range)
          return unless @continuation_state[:source] && range

          @continuation_state[:source][range.line]
        end

        def continuation_selector_on_same_line?(node)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless method_call_with_arguments?(node)

          node.loc.selector.line == node.first_argument.loc.line
        end

        def continuation_assignment_target?(node)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless node

          node.assignment?
        end

        def continuation_root_begin?(node)
          return unless @continuation_state
          return false unless node

          node.root? && node.begin_type?
        end

        def bind_path_context(path, base_dir)
          @path_state = { value: path, base: base_dir, pattern: nil, hidden: path }
        end

        def bind_path_pattern(pattern, path)
          @path_state = { value: path, base: ::Dir.pwd, pattern: pattern, hidden: path }
        end

        def relative_path_from_base
          return @path_state[:value] unless @path_state[:value] && @path_state[:base]

          if path_starts_with_base?
            cut_relative_prefix
          else
            relative_via_pathname
          end
        end

        def path_starts_with_base?

          @path_state[:value].start_with?(@path_state[:base])
        end

        def cut_relative_prefix
          return @path_state[:value] unless @path_state[:value] && @path_state[:base]

          base_dir_length = @path_state[:base].length
          result_length = @path_state[:value].length - base_dir_length - 1
          if result_length.negative?
            @path_state[:value]
          else
            @path_state[:value][base_dir_length + 1, result_length]
          end
        end

        def relative_via_pathname
          return @path_state[:value] unless @path_state[:value] && @path_state[:base]

          path_name = ::Pathname.new(::File.expand_path(@path_state[:value]))
          begin
            path_name.relative_path_from(::Pathname.new(@path_state[:base])).to_s
          rescue ArgumentError
            @path_state[:value]
          end
        end

        def smart_path_for

          if path_is_remote_config?
            remote_config_uri
          elsif path_inside_working_directory?
            relative_path_from_base
          else
            @path_state[:value]
          end
        end

        def path_is_remote_config?

          @path_state[:value].is_a?(RuboCop::RemoteConfig)
        end

        def remote_config_uri

          @path_state[:value].uri.to_s
        end

        def path_inside_working_directory?

          @path_state[:value].start_with?(@path_state[:base])
        end

        def match_path_pattern?
          return unless @path_state

          if path_string_pattern?
            string_pattern_matches_path? || hidden_file_in_not_hidden_dir?
          elsif path_regexp_pattern?
            regexp_pattern_matches_path?
          end
        end

        def string_pattern_matches_path?
          return false unless @path_state[:pattern].is_a?(String) && @path_state[:value]

          if path_equal_to_pattern?
            true
          elsif glob_pattern?
            ::File.fnmatch?(path_expand_glob_pattern, @path_state[:value], path_fnmatch_flags(false))
          else
            false
          end
        end

        def glob_pattern?

          @path_state[:pattern].is_a?(String) && @path_state[:pattern].match?(/[*{\[?]/)
        end

        def regexp_pattern_matches_path?
          return false unless @path_state[:pattern].is_a?(Regexp) && @path_state[:value]

          begin
            @path_state[:pattern].match?(@path_state[:value])
          rescue ArgumentError => e
            return false if path_invalid_byte_sequence?(e)

            raise e
          end
        end

        def glob_path?
          return false unless @path_state

          path_has_glob_characters?
        end

        def absolute_path?
          return false unless @path_state

          path_unix_absolute? || path_windows_absolute?
        end

        def hidden_file_in_not_hidden_dir?

          hidden_file_name? &&
            ::File.fnmatch?(
              @path_state[:pattern], @path_state[:value],
              ::File::FNM_PATHNAME | ::File::FNM_EXTGLOB | ::File::FNM_DOTMATCH
            ) &&
            !hidden_dir_name?
        end

        def hidden_file_name?
          return unless @path_state

          maybe_hidden_file_name? && path_basename_hidden?
        end

        def maybe_hidden_file_name?
          return false unless path_contains_hidden_pattern?

          separator_index = path_separator_index
          return false unless separator_index

          dot_index = @path_state[:hidden].index('.', separator_index + 1)
          dot_index == separator_index + 1
        end

        def hidden_dir_name?

          ::File.dirname(@path_state[:hidden]).split(::File::SEPARATOR).any? do |dir|
            dir.start_with?('.')
          end
        end

        def path_has_glob_characters?

          @path_state[:value].include?('*') ||
            @path_state[:value].include?('{') ||
            @path_state[:value].include?('[') ||
            @path_state[:value].include?('?')
        end

        def path_windows_absolute?

          /\A[A-Z]:/i.match?(@path_state[:value]) && @path_state[:value].include?('/')
        end

        def path_unix_absolute?

          @path_state[:value].start_with?('/')
        end

        def path_parent_reference?

          @path_state[:pattern].is_a?(String) && @path_state[:pattern].start_with?('..')
        end

        def bind_breakable_context(owner, node, max)
          @breakable_state = { owner: owner, node: node, max: max, elements: nil, index: nil }
        end

        def extract_breakable_node_for_owner

          if breakable_call_type?(@breakable_state[:node])
            return if chained_to_heredoc_receiver?
            @breakable_state[:elements] = process_breakable_args(@breakable_state[:node].arguments)
            extract_breakable_node_from_elements_for_owner
          elsif breakable_method_definition?
            @breakable_state[:elements] = @breakable_state[:node].arguments
            extract_breakable_node_from_elements_for_owner
          elsif breakable_hash_or_array?
            @breakable_state[:elements] = @breakable_state[:node].children
            extract_breakable_node_from_elements_for_owner
          end
        end

        def extract_breakable_node_from_elements_for_owner
          return unless @breakable_state
          return unless breakable_collection_candidate?
          return if breakable_safe_to_ignore?

          line = breakable_processed_line
          return if breakable_line_has_comment?
          return unless breakable_line_too_long?(line)

          extract_first_element_over_column_limit_for_owner
        end

        def extract_first_element_over_column_limit_for_owner

          line = breakable_first_line
          elements = breakable_drop_first_unparenthesized_arg(@breakable_state[:elements])

          @breakable_state[:index] = 0
          @breakable_state[:index] += 1 while within_column_limit_for_owner?(elements[@breakable_state[:index]], line)
          @breakable_state[:index] = shift_elements_for_heredoc_arg_for_owner(elements, @breakable_state[:index])

          return if @breakable_state[:index].nil?
          return elements.first if @breakable_state[:index].zero?

          elements[@breakable_state[:index] - 1]
        end

        def first_argument_is_heredoc_for_owner?

          first_argument = @breakable_state[:node].first_argument
          first_argument.respond_to?(:heredoc?) && first_argument.heredoc?
        end

        def shift_elements_for_heredoc_arg_for_owner(elements, index)
          return index unless @breakable_state[:node]
          return index unless @breakable_state[:node].call_type? || @breakable_state[:node].array_type?

          heredoc_index = elements.index { |arg| arg.respond_to?(:heredoc?) && arg.heredoc? }
          return index unless heredoc_index
          return nil if heredoc_index.zero?

          heredoc_index >= index ? index : heredoc_index + 1
        end

        def within_column_limit_for_owner?(element, line)

          element && element.loc.column <= @breakable_state[:max] && element.loc.line == line
        end

        def breakable_safe_to_ignore?
          return unless @breakable_state
          return true unless breakable_owner_max
          return true if already_on_multiple_lines_for_owner?
          return true if contained_by_breakable_collection_on_same_line_for_owner?
          return true if contained_by_multiline_collection_that_could_be_broken_up_for_owner?

          false
        end

        def breakable_collection_candidate?

          starts_with_bracket = !@breakable_state[:node].hash_type? || @breakable_state[:node].loc.begin
          has_second_element = @breakable_state[:elements].length >= 2
          starts_with_bracket && has_second_element
        end

        def contained_by_breakable_collection_on_same_line_for_owner?

          @breakable_state[:node].each_ancestor.find do |ancestor|
            break unless breakable_ancestor_same_line?(ancestor)

            if breakable_collection_type?(ancestor)
              elements = ancestor.children
            elsif breakable_call_type?(ancestor)
              elements = process_breakable_args(ancestor.arguments)
            else
              next
            end

            return true if breakable_collection_for?(ancestor, elements)
          end

          false
        end

        def contained_by_multiline_collection_that_could_be_broken_up_for_owner?

          @breakable_state[:node].each_ancestor.find do |ancestor|
